# Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

> The CDC is the United States' premier public health agency providing authoritative disease prevention, outbreak tracking, vaccination guidance, and health condition information.

CDC.gov serves as the official source for public health information, disease surveillance, and prevention strategies for infectious and chronic diseases. The site offers comprehensive resources in English and Spanish, covering everything from current outbreak alerts to vaccination recommendations and health condition management.

## Key Topics

- COVID-19
- Influenza (Flu)
- Vaccination
- Disease Prevention
- Outbreak Tracking
- Infectious Diseases
- Public Health
- Preventive Care
- Health Conditions
- Immunization
- Disease Surveillance
- Health Topics
- Occupational Health
- Overdose Prevention
- Tick-borne Diseases

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC](https://cdc.gov): CDC homepage with public health information and disease prevention resources
- [Health Topics | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/health-topics.html): A-Z index of CDC health topics including diseases, safety, and global health
- [CDC Current Outbreak List | Outbreaks | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/outbreaks/index.html): Current outbreak tracking and disease surveillance resources from CDC
- [About CDC | About CDC | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/about): CDC organization, mission, leadership, and structure information
- [Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/spanish): Spanish-language CDC homepage for disease prevention and health topics

## Vaccination & Immunization

- [What Vaccines are Recommended for You | Adult Vaccines | CDC](https://cdc.gov/vaccines-adults/recommended-vaccines/index.html): Adult vaccination recommendations including COVID-19, flu, and Tdap vaccines
- [About Measles | Measles (Rubeola) | CDC](https://cdc.gov/measles/about/index.html): Measles disease information and MMR vaccine protection recommendations

## Infectious Disease Prevention & Symptoms

- [How to Protect Yourself and Others | COVID-19 | CDC](https://cdc.gov/covid/prevention/index.html): COVID-19 prevention guidance including vaccination and protective measures
- [Signs and Symptoms of Flu | Influenza (Flu) | CDC](https://cdc.gov/flu/signs-symptoms/index.html): Flu symptoms, diagnosis, complications, and high-risk group information
- [Signs and Symptoms of Bird Flu in People | Bird Flu | CDC](https://cdc.gov/bird-flu/signs-symptoms/index.html): Avian influenza A(H5) virus signs, symptoms, and disease severity information
- [About Lyme Disease | Lyme Disease | CDC](https://cdc.gov/lyme/about/index.html): Lyme disease overview including tick-borne transmission and prevention strategies
- [About Hantavirus | Hantavirus | CDC](https://cdc.gov/hantavirus/about/index.html): Hantavirus overview including transmission, symptoms, and treatment information
- [Preventing Dengue | Dengue | CDC](https://cdc.gov/dengue/prevention): Dengue prevention through mosquito control and insect repellent guidance
- [Handwashing Facts | Clean Hands | CDC](https://cdc.gov/clean-hands/data-research/facts-stats): Handwashing facts and statistics on disease prevention and infection control

## Chronic Disease & Health Conditions

- [Preventing Type 2 Diabetes | Diabetes | CDC](https://cdc.gov/diabetes/prevention-type-2/index.html): Type 2 diabetes prevention through National DPP lifestyle changes and risk assessment
- [About High Blood Pressure | High Blood Pressure | CDC](https://cdc.gov/high-blood-pressure/about/index.html): High blood pressure/hypertension definition, diagnosis, and cardiovascular guidelines
- [About Alzheimer's | Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia | CDC](https://cdc.gov/alzheimers-dementia/about/alzheimers.html): Overview of Alzheimer's disease symptoms, causes, and early-onset information
- [Tips for Maintaining Healthy Weight | Healthy Weight and Growth | CDC](https://cdc.gov/healthy-weight-growth/about/tips-for-balancing-food-activity.html): Healthy weight maintenance tips using MyPlate and physical activity guidelines

## Injury Prevention & Public Health Threats

- [Preventing Opioid Overdose | Overdose Prevention | CDC](https://cdc.gov/overdose-prevention/prevention/index.html): Opioid overdose prevention strategies and fentanyl harm reduction approaches
